title: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:377 - SelectChannel epoch byte order inconsistent
description: SelectChannel pseudocode at line 377 specifies 'Epoch as LE u32 bytes' for hashing, but the beacon format at line 44 says 'Multi-byte integers unsigned big-endian'. This inconsistency between hash input encoding and wire format could cause channel selection mismatches between implementations that follow different sections.
